title: Creamy Squash Soup with Shredded Apples

ingredients.name: frozen pureed winter (butternut) squash, 16 ounces each
apples, such as Golden Delicious or Gala

steps.instruction: Place the 2 boxes of frozen squash in a microwave-safe dish and cover it loosely.
Microwave on medium power for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Microwave on medium power for 5 to ten minutes, until the squash is mostly thawed.

steps.instruction: Peel 2 medium apples and shred them with a grater or food processor.
steps.spoken: Peel the apples, then shred them with a grater or food processor. Or chop them finely into thin strips.

steps.instruction: Set aside 1/4 cup of the shredded apples.
Warm 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Add all but 1/4 cup of the apples to the pan.
steps.spoken: Add the apples and cook and stir for about 5 minutes, until they soften.

steps.instruction: Stir in the thawed squash and 1/2 teaspoon of pumpkin pie spice.
Add 2 cans of evaporated milk, about 1/2 cup at a time, stirring after each.
Season with 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Cook and stir over high heat just until the soup is about to boil.
Ladle into bowls and top each with 1 tablespoon of the saved apples.
steps.spoken: Ladle the soup into bowls. Top each with a tablespoon of the apples you set aside. Sprinkle with more pumpkin pie spice if you like.
